info.name: Pioneer DDJ-WeGO
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ's mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-WeGO, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list and rekordbox's list of the DDJ-WeGO's messages.

control.description: BROWSE - rotate - move through the list
SHIFT + BROWSE - rotate - zoom the waveforms
LOAD - load the selected track to deck 1
LOAD - load the selected track to deck 2
LOAD - load the selected track to deck 3
LOAD - load the selected track to deck 4
SHIFT + PLAY/PAUSE - play backwards while held
SHIFT + CUE - back to the start
SHIFT + JOG - move through the track
SHIFT + JOG - move through the track
AUTO LOOP - rotate - halve or double the loop
SHIFT + AUTO LOOP - rotate - move the loop
AUTO LOOP - press - loop on and off
SHIFT + AUTO LOOP - press - reloop or exit
